description: This file defines the 'CompositeDisplayField' class, which is an entity representing a composite display field in the HRM system. It extends an abstract class, includes properties for an ID and a collection of selected composite display fields, and includes methods to get and set its ID.

classes.name: CompositeDisplayField
classes.description: Entity class representing a composite display field with a collection of selected composite display fields. Extends AbstractDisplayField.

properties.name: id
properties.description: Unique identifier for the composite display field.

properties.name: selectedCompositeDisplayFields
properties.description: Collection of selected composite display fields associated with this composite display field.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the composite display field.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the composite display field.
